familiesDescription: WIRE_FORMAT.md 27.8: one record per corpus family (the set 27.7 derives from the tree), keyed by family. `spec` is the section holding the family's normative sentence (a WIRE_FORMAT.md section number, or `<FILE>.md <n>` for a sibling specification). A family is either EMITTED — `producer` {repository, emit} with `source`, the stamp that pins the producer state it was emitted at: `since` (every root row's reference release, 11.3), `kitVersion` (the family file's producer release), or `{commit}` (a producer commit) — or AUTHORED, with the reason no producer emits it. A record may carry `tier`: `"ui"` marks a family whose vectors carry bytes only a UI-tier codec writes, so the substrate cannot emit it and the UI hosts stay its producers (fuaran-core D191). check-family-producers.mjs holds this map to the derived family set: a family with no record, a record for no family, a record with neither or both of producer/authored, a producer with no source, or a spec section the document does not have, is a finding and fails the corpus gate.

chain.authored: the records were generated by the reference HashChain.computeHash (fuaran-ui/fuaran-dotnet, Fuaran.UI.OpStream) when the chain format was cut, and no emit command writes them; fuaran-dotnet's ChainCorpusTests recomputes every hash and previousHash from the pre-image, so a drift reddens the reference rather than rewriting the file

decode-policy.authored: each case names a document, a declared policy and the outcome; the cases are the specification of an optional host narrowing and no host emits them

devtools-relay.authored: relay session transcripts authored against the relay specification; the reference relay suite reads them and no emitter writes them

diff/treeDiff.authored: the (before, after) pairs are authored; each pinned op-script is the output of the shipped structural diff producers of fuaran-ui/fuaran-go (diff/diff.go), fuaran-ui/fuaran-rs (src/diff) and fuaran-ui/fuaran-py (fuaran_ui.ops.diff), recorded per host under `hosts` where they differ in granularity, and every host re-asserts its own; the reference engine (fuaran-ui/fuaran-dotnet TreeOpDiff) differs in granularity from all three and certifies the round-trip law over the same pairs, so no single program emits the file

lowers-to.authored: hand-authored from the section 30 table and never emitted by any host encoder

producer.emit: FUARAN_WIRE_FIXTURES=<corpus dir> FUARAN_REGEN=1 dotnet run --project src/Fuaran.UI.Operability.Tests

repair.authored: the catalogue cases are the specification of the repair function; each host re-measures every verdict

row-encode.authored: each vector is a host-neutral row feed and the outcome the specification states for it: the refusals exist only on the way out, from host values no document can carry, so there are no emitted bytes for a decoder-side emitter to write

sanitization.authored: semantic-invariant payloads, not byte fixtures: each case is a payload and the invariant a rendering host must satisfy, so there are no emitted bytes to produce

stored-emissions.authored: a chosen sample of real stored model emissions; the sample is the point, and every host re-measures the verdicts

teleport-decode.authored: the bundles were produced by the reference teleport encoder and checked in; the root-manifest emitter preserves the rows verbatim and no emit command constructs them yet

teleport-reject.authored: the reference envelope re-stamped by hand with its digest recomputed, so the version refusal is what bites; preserved verbatim by the root emitter
